# cpanel_ip_block (Resource)

Blocks one IP address, CIDR prefix, or address range from cPanel-hosted websites.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_ip_block" "office" {
  address = "203.0.113.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The IP address, CIDR prefix, or `start-end` range to block.

### Read-Only

- `end_address` (String) The normalized last address in the blocked range.
- `start_address` (String) The normalized first address in the blocked range.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_ip_block.office 203.0.113.0/24
```
